method: Rechecked captured profile hashes, numerical sources and finite arrays. Recomputed apparent horizon from expansion sign change and local degree-six interpolation; compared to saved history. Exterior maxima use nodes r>=r_AH. Full-grid maxima and all original acceptance tests retain every node.
scope: Diagnostic localization only. Apparent horizon is not an event-horizon determination. Accurate horizon mass or small exterior error cannot override failed full-domain constraints. Mass errors near machine precision do not establish convergence order. Partial finest history is not full-time convergence.
